# A typed form field or path value that fails to parse on an execute route or
# an sse route answers 400 with the parse error as a text/plain body, as a
# url-encoded form that request.ParseForm rejects does.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /allocations CreateAllocation(form, execute)" -}}hours: {{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /allocations/{id} ShowAllocation(id, execute)" -}}id: {{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
{{- define "POST /events sse(Stream(ctx, form, execute))" -}}hours: {{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type AllocationForm struct {
	Person string `name:"person"`
	Hours  int    `name:"hours"`
}

type Server struct{}

func (Server) CreateAllocation(f AllocationForm, execute func(data int) error) error {
	return execute(f.Hours)
}

func (Server) ShowAllocation(id int, execute func(data int) error) error {
	return execute(id)
}

func (Server) Stream(_ context.Context, f AllocationForm, execute func(data int) error) error {
	return execute(f.Hours)
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestParseErrorBody(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tt := range []struct {
		name   string
		method string
		target string
		form   url.Values
	}{
		{name: "execute form field", method: http.MethodPost, target: "/allocations", form: url.Values{"hours": {"abc"}}},
		{name: "execute path value", method: http.MethodGet, target: "/allocations/abc"},
		{name: "sse form field", method: http.MethodPost, target: "/events", form: url.Values{"hours": {"abc"}}},
	} {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			mux := http.NewServeMux()
			TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})
			req := httptest.NewRequest(tt.method, tt.target, strings.NewReader(tt.form.Encode()))
			if tt.form != nil {
				req.Header.Set("content-type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
			}
			rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
			if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
				t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
			}
			if ct := rec.Header().Get("content-type"); !strings.HasPrefix(ct, "text/plain") {
				t.Errorf("content-type = %q, want text/plain", ct)
			}
			if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, `strconv.Atoi: parsing "abc"`) {
				t.Errorf("body = %q, want the strconv parse error naming the bad value", body)
			}
		})
	}
}
